people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: and didn’t know her sexually until she had given birth to her firstborn son. He named him Jesus.
translations.bsb: But he had no union with her until she gave birth to a Son. And he gave Him the name Jesus.
translations.kjv: And knew her not till she had brought forth her firstborn son: and he called his name JESUS.
translations.asv: and knew her not till she had brought forth a son: and he called his name JESUS.
